name: Intro: What Am I To You

lines.lyric: Come here I’m bout to take u higher
lines.lyric_hangul: Come here I'm bout to take you higher
lines.lyric_translation: Come here I’m bout to take u higher

lines.lyric: We about to set this love on fire
lines.lyric_hangul: We about to set this love on fire
lines.lyric_translation: We about to set this love on fire
I’ve never felt like this before
My mom couldn’t even stop me
I told you how I really felt
And in the end, I won

lines.lyric: Baby u should know u change
lines.lyric_hangul: Baby you should know you change
lines.lyric_translation: Baby u should know u change

lines.lyric: All of my negatives to positive
lines.lyric_hangul: All of my negatives to positive
lines.lyric_translation: All of my negatives to positive
You put up your thorns
but I can see you’re a rose
who’s making my heart race again
The person is you
I still don’t know but

lines.lyric: Naega jeonbu da alge halge dangsineul
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 전부 다 알게 할게 당신을
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll make you know everything about me

lines.lyric: Na nan doegopa neo neoui oppa
lines.lyric_hangul: 나 난 되고파 너 너의 오빠
lines.lyric_translation: I want to be your oppa
I want to be recognized differently than the other dudes
It might seem like a typical line from a movie
but I have a sixth sense

lines.lyric: Yo I’ll be different I’ll be missin
lines.lyric_hangul: Yo I'll be different I'll be missin
lines.lyric_translation: Yo I’ll be different I’ll be missin

lines.lyric: I’ll be kissin ya all the time girl
lines.lyric_hangul: I'll be kissin ya all the time girl
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll be kissin ya all the time girl

lines.lyric: Nuneul ttebwado mameun ttel suga eobseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 눈을 떼봐도 맘은 뗄 수가 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I can take my eyes off you but I can’t take my heart off you

lines.lyric: Ja ije sijagiya I’m yo poketmonseuteo
lines.lyric_hangul: 자 이제 시작이야 I'm yo 포켓몬스터
lines.lyric_translation: Now this is the beginning, I’m yo pocket monster

lines.lyric: Neodo mameul jugo nado nae mam da jwosseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너도 맘을 주고 나도 내 맘 다 줬어
lines.lyric_translation: You gave me your heart and I gave you all of mine
Today is happier than yesterday
But why, but why

lines.lyric: Joeincheoreom honja nege yeollakhal pinggyereul chatji
lines.lyric_hangul: 죄인처럼 혼자 네게 연락할 핑계를 찾지 (Uh)
lines.lyric_translation: Why am I finding an excuse to call you like I’m a sinner
It’s worse than before we started dating
It is not enough that we are a couple?
You always give short answers like yes, I’m sleeping, no
Your messages don’t exceed 10 bytes
You’re like a goalkeeper who has lost her will
I’m like Messi, running all over the place

lines.lyric: Geurae cheoeumbuteo ige gongpyeonghal su eomneun
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래 처음부터 이게 공평할 수 없는
lines.lyric_translation: I knew this wans’t from the start
a fair game
It’s not that I wanted to win over you
But I didn’t want to keep losing either

lines.lyric: Jogeumeun daldalhage, mak kkaega ssodajijin anhado
lines.lyric_hangul: 조금은 달달하게, 막 깨가 쏟아지진 않아도
lines.lyric_translation: Even if we’re not couple-y and affectionate
I want to link arms with you like everyone else
And comfort each other and really mean it
What’s best for each other,
the fact that you have a dry personality, I understand

lines.lyric: Nan hangsang neoui mite seo isseunikka under-stand
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 항상 너의 밑에 서 있으니까 under-stand
lines.lyric_translation: Because I’m always below you, under stand
It’s like I’m carrying you on my shoulders,
I can’t do anything
My bitter smile has become a habit at some point

lines.lyric: Neon tto, jochido nappeujido antago hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 또, 좋지도 나쁘지도 않다고 해
lines.lyric_translation: And you say you don’t like me but you don’t hate me either

lines.lyric: Naega apseogani? anin geon anin geonde
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 앞서가니? 아닌 건 아닌 건데
lines.lyric_translation: Am I rushing things? But if it’s not it, it’s not it

lines.lyric: Nae jjak inneun jjaksarang nan barae,
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 짝 있는 짝사랑 난 바래
lines.lyric_translation: I have a partner in this puppy love,
I just want to freely love

lines.lyric: Jom jabajwo igeon kkok sangdae eomneun
lines.lyric_hangul: 좀 잡아줘 이건 꼭 상대 없는
lines.lyric_translation: Hold me, this is like a game
of tug-of-war without an opponent What you say
ahh baby don’t you play
Even if you’re a fiery road, I’ll firmly walk on it
So please, don’t look at me as if
you’re looking at a stranger
when I was nothing to you,
I keep thinking about those times

lines.lyric: What am I to you girl what am I to you
lines.lyric_hangul: What am I to you girl what am I to you
lines.lyric_translation: What am I to you girl what am I to you

lines.lyric: I do love you crazy uh do you?
lines.lyric_hangul: I do love you crazy uh do you?
lines.lyric_translation: I do love you crazy uh do you?

lines.lyric: Iraetda jeoraetda saram mam jom hetgallige haji ma
lines.lyric_hangul: 이랬다 저랬다 사람 맘 좀 헷갈리게 하지 마
lines.lyric_translation: Like this and like that, stop confusing me

lines.lyric: Jakku ittansigil geomyeon gyeyakseoe dojang jjikja
lines.lyric_hangul: 자꾸 이딴식일 거면 계약서에 도장 찍자
lines.lyric_translation: If you’re gonna keep this up, let’s write up a contract

lines.lyric: Harue ppoppo myeot beon katok myeot beon
lines.lyric_hangul: 하루에 뽀뽀 몇 번 카톡 몇 번
lines.lyric_translation: X number of kisses per day, x number of texts per day
Will I feel better, if we do that?
What am I to you girl what am I to you
